# Borings, Baddies & Bastards (B3)

> B3 is a free, pass-the-phone social deduction party game for 3-20 players: one phone, one secret word, and three roles scrambling to work out who is faking it.

## Pages

- [B3 home](https://b3.happypaul55.com/): what the game is, the three roles, the round flow and the scoring.
- [Play](https://b3.happypaul55.com/play): the game itself - pick a category, pass the phone around and vote.
- [Rules](https://b3.happypaul55.com/rules): full rules, round-by-round flow, scoring tables and frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy](https://b3.happypaul55.com/privacy): what the game sends, what it does not store and how the human check works.

## How it plays

A category is chosen and a secret word is generated by AI on the server. Everyone sees the word except the Baddies, who must bluff. The Bastard sees the word but wants to be accused. Players discuss, then vote; scoring rewards each role differently.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/HappyPaul55/borings-baddies-bastards) - released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0.
- [HappyPaul55](https://www.happypaul55.com/) - the author's site.

## Notes

- No accounts, no cookies of its own and no analytics; the typed category is sent to the site's own endpoint and on to the AI provider to generate words.
- Opening the game runs a Cloudflare Turnstile human check; the resulting 30-minute session token is kept in sessionStorage.
